8 · Knockout

NewThe risk

A dark scrim across the whole frame with the words cut clean out of it, so the vehicle is what you read the type through. It is the one template here that does something no other dealer in the market is doing. Works best over a moving shot, because the motion inside the letters is the whole effect.

One technical caveat. A transparent PNG can be see-through, but it cannot blur what is behind it. Templates 4, 7 and 9 show a blur because the page can render one live. On export you get the same panels without the blur, which still works, or the Media team adds a blurred mask in the editor once per template and reuses it. Tell me which and I will cut them accordingly.

Your new pieces, folded in

Chevrons, the outline and chrome badges, and the hex material

The lockupFilled green word over an outlined word, chevrons leading in. Reproduced below in Michroma, the closest wide tech face available.
Outline badgeUsed for the opening reveal, the wipe, and the watermark. It reads as drawn, which the white badge cannot do.
Chrome badgeReserved for the end card and the slate, where it is big enough for the bevel to read. Too detailed for small marks.
Two greens. The banner uses #80FF00. The chevrons and outline badge use #15FF22, a purer green. Everything on this page is drawn in the banner green so it matches what is already approved. If the purer green is the real EAW green, it is one value to change and the whole kit follows. Your call.

Four rules that apply to every frame

Carried over from the dealer comment standard. They matter more on video, because overlays get screenshotted and reshared without the listing attached.

  1. No prices, no MSRP, no payments, any lane.A screenshot of a price outlives the price.
  2. No vehicle history on screen.No owner counts, no accident language, no Carfax stills.
  3. No mileage unless the number itself is the story, and only when verified in HomeNet.93,862 on a 1994 earns a frame. 41,200 on a 2022 does not.
  4. Three chips maximum in any one frame, six across an entire video.Over the ceiling means you are listing. Cut specs, never voice.
